label: ext.blocktype ext.tool
createStatement: CREATE (b:ext.blocktype {id: $id, name: $name, properties: $properties, requiredProperties: $requiredProperties, semantics: $semantics, status: $status})

createParameters.name: ext.tool

properties.description: what the tool does, in the words a run reads
properties.inputSchema: the JSON Schema of the tool's input
properties.name: the tool's name as a run sees it, unique among the tools a run is offered
properties.route: the extension's server route, under /api/x/<extId>/, the kernel posts a call to

createParameters.semantics: Declares an agent tool an extension answers. The kernel's toolset offers it while the extension is active and hands a call to the route with the calling run; what the route writes is staged into that run's proposal group. Never materializes to the working tree. BO_0264
